provider_limitation: RunPod's official REST, GraphQL, and runpodctl observations do not expose a non-empty exact data-center ID for the stopped recovered source. No source data-center ID is inferred or fabricated.
scientific_constraint: H6 continuation is content-addressed. Destination admission requires the exact frozen image, GPU, CUDA, Python, package, reports, checkpoints, tokenizer, training-only selection, evaluator, and platform fingerprint; it does not require the recovered source pod's physical data center.

decision.reason: It was the only officially listed RTX 5090 candidate with Medium rather than Low availability at observation time.
decision.fallback_rule: There is no in-ledger fallback. Capacity or exact-runtime admission failure ends this continuation before development release. A later candidate requires fresh provider evidence and a new no-clobber continuation authority.
decision.hard_gate: No development artifact may be transferred until a destination passes the exact frozen runtime admission.

data_classification: public synthetic Nano evidence only; no private corpus
network_volume_encryption_disclosure: RunPod network volumes are not encrypted. This continuation permits them only because every transferred artifact is non-private synthetic project evidence.
